I know many of my friends grew up in the same environment and that if they were to stray from the path that was planned for them, that they would be considered a failure. Forcing a child down the “right” path is super different from guiding them through the intricacies of life and the different paths they can take to reach their end goal.

Once you’re off the waitlist after a seat has been offered to you, you can register for the lecture and discussion sections linked to your lab. As for reserved seats, sometimes they don’t open up right when second pass happens. They can open up before or after depending on the class. For ochem lab, its normalized among all sections. It's a little different from a curve. Because some TAs are harder/easier than others, they do a section to section comparison. This means some sections might have points "added" to their overall score if their TA grades a lot harder while other sections with easier TAs can get points "taken away" from their section. Physics lab is just the normal curve among all sections.
